title: Senior Research Scientist, AI & Workforce Intelligence - Remote, 4-Day Work Week
options: Remote [remote]
description:
> [under: What Makes Wonderlic Different?] - Fully Remote: Anywhere in the U.S; Chicago HQ
> # About Us
> # Do meaningful work. Work from anywhere. Enjoy a four-day workweek.
> [under: Do meaningful work. Work from anywhere. Enjoy a four-day workweek.] We’re a remote-first company offering a full-time, 32-hour workweek across four days, giving our team more time to focus on what matters at work and beyond it.
> [under: Do meaningful work. Work from anywhere. Enjoy a four-day workweek.] Our mission is to create a world where everyone finds and thrives in their best job—and that starts with us.
> [under: Do meaningful work. Work from anywhere. Enjoy a four-day workweek.] We combine decades of science-based assessment expertise with industrial-organizational (I-O) psychology, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to deliver evidence-based insights that help organizations make smarter employment decisions.
> [under: Do meaningful work. Work from anywhere. Enjoy a four-day workweek.] We’re proud to bring the same thoughtful, evidence-based approach to how we work as we do to the solutions we create.
> # What Sets Us Apart
> [under: What Sets Us Apart] - Lasting Impact: By integrating I-O psychology and evidence-based insights, we help organizations hire more effectively, develop talent, and improve long-term employee success and retention.
[under: What You’ll Do] Drive Scientific Rigor: Apply I-O psychology principles - adverse impact consideration, norm group construction, and evidence-based evaluation standards - to every system you build.
[under: Skills & Capabilities] - Generative AI evaluation skills: rubric-based review, groundedness checks, error analysis, regression testing, and evaluation of LLM-generated job descriptions, work-context summaries, and assessment result contextualization.
[under: Qualifications] - Experience applying modern NLP methods to behavioral, assessment-based, or labor market data
[under: Compensation] - $130,000 to $150,000 based on experience and expertise.
> [under: Our Policy] Here, diversity is valued and celebrated, and this is what makes us such a successful team.

description:
# Porto, Portugal | Product Engineering
[under: Why SOFICO?] Miles supports complex business processes throughout the full lifecycle of a finance or leasing contract — from quotation and pricing to contract management, billing, assets, services and integrations.
[under: Your role] This is a hands-on product development role where you’ll translate business and domain requirements into Java services, APIs and microservice-based solutions.
[under: Your role] You’ll be working in a complex enterprise domain where maintainability, scalability, reliability and long-term product evolution matter.
[under: What’s in it for you...] - Hybrid working and flexible hours, giving you the freedom to shape your workday;
[under: What’s in it for you...] - Join an international, multicultural company with more than 35 years of experience, doubling in size every 5 years. We hold on to a horizontal, open culture where career development and personal growth stay central, with ongoing learning opportunities well beyond your onboarding. Our office is modern and easily accessible, with charging stations for electric cars and bikes, plus free shared bikes to grab lunch.
